title: Honeyed Spicy Peruvian Chickpea Tiradito
description: A meal-prep Peruvian dish featuring chickpeas, a fusion of sweet and spicy flavors, served as a low-glycemic-friendly breakfast or snack.
instructions: In a blender, combine aji amarillo peppers, garlic, lime juice, and 1/2 teaspoon salt; blend until smooth.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the blended aji amarillo mixture and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in chickpeas, honey, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper; cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Toss in thinly sliced red onion and cook for 1 minute, until slightly caramelized.
Season with additional salt and black pepper to taste.
Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Divide the chilled mixture among 4-6 serving containers, depending on serving size.
Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
To serve, divide the chilled mixture among bowls and garnish with additional lime wedges, if desired.
